# Date

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/date` (default export). Primitive calendar date, serialized `YYYY-MM-DD`; renders localized. For date pairs use Date Range.

## Usage
```ts
import DateField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/date';
```

Example: value `"2026-08-14"`
